notes.title: 10 Second Ninja X Aims Shuriken At July Release
notes.notes:
The original 10 Second Ninja is a strange beast in that it will kill you time and time and time again, yet can be completed in one single sitting. Well, assuming you’re not fussed about hitting its elusive three-star reward on each level. If you are, then you’d better put the kettle on. 
Its follow-up, 10 Second Ninja X [official site], was revealed earlier this year and looks to offer more of the same. Today publisher Curve Digital set July 19th as its launch day and marked the occasion with a new trailer:

notes.title: Controller Support and Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
Hi all! We’ve just released a new update to fix some of the controller troubles people have been having, as well as the glitched scores that have been plaguing the leaderboard. 

We've also included a "Clutch Mode" option in the settings to make it harder to restart levels by accident by remapping retry to Back on the Xbox 360 controller.

With this update comes a leaderboard wipe, but don’t worry; so long as you still have your save file, you can just boot the game and re-upload your times.

Thanks for being ace!
